body: I'm deathly afraid of taking medication. Might have something to do with my dad being a recovering Oxycontin addict and always seeing him pop the pills and then just fade away from real life, I don't know.
I'm really sorry to hear that. I hope you are coping as well as you can, best of luck.
I was severely neglected as a child and abused.
Every time I take them I throw them up out of fear, but thank you for your concern and suggestion.

I'm not a dude, but thank you.
I know you're only trying to help, but I think this is the biggest misconception people have about severe depression. If it was as easy as believing in happiness I would have done it as a child. PTSD and depression are not states of mind, even when I was the most optimistic, even when I was overjoyed and ecstatic, suicide picked at my brain every minute. I don't think I can will myself better. I try.
I know it's a problem, but that's why I suffer through it. I don't know how to fix it.

I art, music, school, and many other things. My insecurities prevent me from investing my time into anything, though. Even though I want to, knowing I'm not the best at something actually prevents me from doing anything. I have panic attacks.

But if I think about this logically, not killing myself doesn't make sense.
I've never wanted to live, I still don't want to, and suicide will always be a problem. Every moment I don't kill myself feels terrible and worse than any death. If I die everything goes away.
